messages:
Nina (Marketing): Rob flagged a region-wide spike in errors for EU-Central at 08:03 UTC. we need quick copy for status and a decision on customer emails (some big trial accounts affected).
Rob (SRE): confirmed — 502/timeout increase, roughly 2% of traffic, affect embeddings and batched calls. rollback attempt in progress, ETA 25-40m.
Priya (Support): getting chat escalations. customers ask if their API keys or data were exposed. need a simple line for support replies.
Clare (Comms): draft line for public and support: "Service impact in EU-Central causing higher error rates and latency for a subset of requests. No indications of data exposure." keep it simple.
Hector (Sales Ops): we have a webinar in 90m targeted at EU customers. recommend postponing or adding a brief note at start. Sales expects to route any inbound demo requests to AEs immediately.
Nina (Marketing): agree on postponing the webinar by 24h unless resolved within 60m. don't want to start a live demo during an active incident.
Rob (SRE): posted initial status page entry: "Investigating — elevated errors in EU-Central affecting embeddings and batch inference. Engineers are rolling back a config change. Next update in 20 minutes."
incident-bot: "Incident 1901 created — EU-Central elevated errors — severity: Sev2"
Priya (Support): canned reply suggestion: "We're investigating elevated errors in the EU-Central region. Your data and keys are secure; we'll update you in our next status post: status.redwood.com/1901. If you need immediate routing assistance, reply and we'll help."
Clare (Comms): email subject options for affected customers:
- "Redwood update: Performance issue in EU-Central — we're on it"
- "Action required? Temporary performance issue in EU-Central"
Nina (Marketing): pick the first. we'll send only to accounts with traffic in region after 30m if still degraded. Hector: prepare AE routing list.
Hector (Sales Ops): will mark active trials + named accounts and notify AEs via DM. Also suggest tagging incoming leads from our website as "incident-1901" so SDRs prioritize follow-up.
Rob (SRE): if error rate >3% after 30m we enable automatic cross-region failover for eligible Dedicated customers. otherwise manual assist only.
Clare (Comms): social policy: no external posts until resolved. internal post with root cause and slide for PR after RC.
Nina (Marketing): timeline recap: post status now (Rob), support canned responses live, hold webinar if not resolved in 60m, email at 30m if impact persists, final wrap email when resolved.
Priya (Support): I'll push canned messages to Zendesk and ping the support channel.
Rob (SRE): update coming in 20m or sooner.
Nina (Marketing): thanks all. stand by for the 30m go/no-go on email + webinar. :thumbsup:
